subject: English
question_text: The chart below shows a comparison between e-mails,
stimulus: phone conversation and face to face meeting. Write a paragraph describing it. 10 Name of media time reliable efficient communication consumling less mor less mor less more e e E-mails    Phone    conversation Face to face    meeting
guide_solution: Graph & charts The above mentioned chart illustrates a comparison about media communication. There are three types of media of communication mentioned in the chart. According to the chart we observe that Emails are less time-consuming and less reliable. But it is more efficient. Phone conversation is less time-consuming and less reliable. But it is less efficient. Today's world is an era of advancement of communication due to technological triumph. Emails, Mobile phone are glaring examples of such technological triumph. These things have eased our lifestyle.
